 Created by celebrity makeup artist Mary Phillips, the gloss is a favorite of stars like Jennifer Lopez.

 A little lip gloss can go a long way, especially when it comes with Oprah's seal of approval. The MPH Beauty Top Coat Lip Gloss is one of the beauty finds featured on Oprah's Favorite Things 2026 list .
 Created by celebrity makeup artist Mary Phillips, whose A-list clients include Jennifer Lopez and Dua Lipa, MPH Beauty brings a little Hollywood glam to your everyday makeup routine.
 It's a great addition to any beauty lover's holiday wish list and the perfect stocking stuffer for someone who loves a little extra shine.
 "These colors in those glosses are gorgeous, and I love that you can see them in their containers," Oprah wrote.
 Available in eight gorgeous shades , the hydrating lip gloss delivers buildable shine with balm-like nourishment and a smooth, non-sticky feel. Makeup artist Mary Phillips, whose clients include Jennifer Lopez and Dua Lipa, suggests a swipe for shine or a layer on any of the eight shades to find a lovely custom hue.
